visualCharacteristics: Heading band on the responsive grid: a small uppercase eyebrow line above a large section title set in the text face (28 / 36 / 42 px).
contentPattern: One cell: eyebrow paragraph(s) followed by a heading (h2); paragraphs before the heading become the eyebrow, the heading and anything after it the title.
usage: Use for a section intro that pairs a short eyebrow label with a large section title.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on any page needing an eyebrow-plus-title section head by authoring one paragraph and one h2 in a single cell.
